content:
jordan_ops: Heads up — vendor shipped H100 batch (AWB XJ12345 / XJ12346) but carrier merged into a single airwaybill at origin, customs flagged because manifest shows 20 units but depot intake shows 18. Need RMA/claims plan. ETA to FRA DC moved to Tue. @maya_sourcing any pricing/credit update?

maya_sourcing: Ack. Pinged vendor — they say merge was to optimize carrier cost. Escalating for split AWBs and per-serial manifest.

liam_logistics: Can vendor provide photos + scannable manifest. Customs needs proof of serial range. Also need original AWB numbers for insurance claims.

vendor_hyper: Sorry about the merge — carrier forced consolidation. Manifest snippet uploaded: ```AWB:XJ12345
SN:H100-0001..H100-0020
Qty:20
Note:2 DOA replaced at origin``` We'll open an RMA and push docs. ETA to uplift replacements Fri.

jordan_ops: That manifest doesn't match depot scans — depot counted 18. Missing serials appear to be H100-0007 and H100-0008. Customs also flagged HS code mismatch. If vendor can't provide immediate splits, we need loaners to avoid infra impact.

maya_sourcing: On pricing — vendor offered 1:1 replacements plus a 50% credit on the 2 missing units (provisional). Roughly ~€200k credit. Need finance signoff.

sam_fw: If replacements delayed >7 days, trigger loaner pool. @liam_logistics please evaluate staging capacity.

liam_logistics: Staging has 12 loaners in FRA but that reduces buffer. Can commit 6 for critical infra if approved.

maya_sourcing: Vendor requested formal RMA ticket with split AWBs, photos, and serial-mapped picklist. We've asked for it.

jordan_ops: Uploading depot intake logs for reference: ```DEPT_INT|AWB|SN|STATUS
2026-03-10|XJ12345|H100-0001|OK
2026-03-10|XJ12345|H100-0002|OK
...
2026-03-10|XJ12345|H100-0007|MISSING
2026-03-10|XJ12345|H100-0008|MISSING```

vendor_hyper: Uploaded high-res photos + signed packing list to S3: https://s3.vendor/claim/1758884444 . RMA ref VH-2026-78. We will expedite 2 replacements via air uplift.

liam_logistics: Customs also wants original invoice showing HS code 8471.90. Vendor, can you confirm and provide corrected invoice?

vendor_hyper: Confirm HS code 8471.90. Updated invoice and credit note draft uploaded to the S3 link.

jordan_ops: Operationally recommend: hold units from entering cluster until serial reconciliation completes. If replacements arrive, route 2 DOAs to depot repair, declare missing units lost and start claim vs carrier/vendor. Approve this flow?

maya_sourcing: Provisional approve. Waiting on finance sign-off for the 50% credit. @sophie_finance please confirm.

sophie_finance: We can accept 50% credit for 2 units pending receipt of official credit note and updated invoice. Finance needs vendor's credit note before we close the case.

vendor_hyper: Will provide formal credit note within 48h and booking confirmation for air uplift. ETA for replacements 72h after uplift booked.

jordan_ops: Thanks all — I'll pause capacity allocation for that cluster and update runbooks. :thumbsup:
